data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Firebase Installations API
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to interact with the Firebase Installations service to manage unique identifiers for Firebase installations. It provides methods to create, retrieve, and delete installation IDs.
use_when: You need to access or manage unique Firebase installation identifiers in your app.
Building services that rely on Firebase Installations API integration.
avoid_when: You only need standard analytics or crash reporting without directly managing installation IDs.
strengths: Official Firebase plugin supporting Android, iOS, and macOS.
weaknesses: Limited functionality scope restricted solely to Firebase Installations.
Requires platform-specific configuration and native SDK setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing firebase_core, configuring native Firebase projects for Android and Apple platforms, and meeting minimum SDK requirements (minSdk 24 for Android, macOS 11 for macOS).

// See official documentation for usage details
